paragraphs: Gamliel Dekontyah. Rabbi Mana released his vow (see his entry). The people of Kursai buried him among them. After three days they decided to bring him back and asked Rabbi Simon; he answered them in the name of Rabbi Yehoshua ben Levi: Jerusalem Talmud, Ellu Megallechin, halakhah 5.
